description: A research agent searches public social networks (Bluesky, Mastodon and public accounts) on a schedule for what one person wants followed: places, topics in each place's languages, public figures, accounts. Reads your human's brief into a proposal: what it understood, the places, search terms, people and accounts, each search, setup items, questions, and the monthly price (quote). Nothing is created or charged. Then show it to your human and refine it, or create it. Free; it needs the Quorumz API key on this connection and counts as one of the key owner's 30 agent-chat turns a day.

brief.description: What your human wants followed, in their words and any language: places, topics, people, accounts, what to leave out, how often.
brief.title: Brief

plan.description: starter (the default) or pro: pro searches more often and more widely, for a higher price.
plan.title: Plan
